metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.
metric_policy.storage_note: Unpacked behavioral memory arrays are reported as memory_bit_count, not flipflop_count.

registers.name: PARAM_REQUEST_ID_WIDTH
registers.description: Parameter value exposed for firmware visibility only; encodes REQUEST_ID_WIDTH as a 32-bit little-endian value across four byte lanes in the abstract minimal map.

registers.name: PARAM_SEQ_WIDTH
registers.description: Parameter value exposed for firmware visibility only; encodes SEQ_WIDTH as a 32-bit little-endian value across four byte lanes in the abstract minimal map.

registers.name: PARAM_COMMAND_WIDTH
registers.description: Parameter value exposed for firmware visibility only; encodes COMMAND_WIDTH as a 32-bit little-endian value across four byte lanes in the abstract minimal map.

registers.name: PARAM_COMMAND_MIN
registers.description: Programmable minimum command bound. Exposed as 32-bit little-endian bytes.

registers.name: PARAM_COMMAND_MAX
registers.description: Programmable maximum command bound. Exposed as 32-bit little-endian bytes.

registers.name: PARAM_FRESHNESS_WINDOW_CYCLES
registers.description: Freshness window parameter for response acceptance; 32-bit little-endian representation.

registers.name: PARAM_SAFE_FALLBACK_COMMAND
registers.description: Safe fallback actuator command; synthesis-time default may be overridden by secure register programming if enabled by system integration policy. The command remains subject to clamp limits.

registers.name: HOST_OPERATING_EN_MIN_MPS
registers.description: Host-programmable minimum operating envelope in m/s used by request qualification. If host integration does not override, the default behavioral floor is 20.0 m/s.

fields.name: BYTE0
fields.description: Minimum envelope byte 0; unit/encoding is implementation-defined fixed-point or integer-compatible register storage.

registers.name: HOST_OPERATING_EN_MAX_MPS
registers.description: Host-programmable maximum operating envelope in m/s used by request qualification. If host integration does not override, the default behavioral ceiling is 55.0 m/s.

fields.name: BYTE0
fields.description: Maximum envelope byte 0; unit/encoding is implementation-defined fixed-point or integer-compatible register storage.

registers.name: HOST_FRESHNESS_WINDOW_CYCLES
registers.description: Host-programmable freshness window override. Takes effect in the response validator on the next synchronous boundary.

registers.name: HOST_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_CYCLES
registers.description: Host-programmable response timeout override. Used by supervisory timeout policy and outstanding-transaction management.
